I'm checking whether dose scales proportionally: the 200 dose peaks come out roughly 3.7 to 3.9 times the 50 dose ones, and the concentrations at 12 and 24 hours show a similar ratio, so the relationship looks close to linear. I'm also starting on the elimination rate, working from the drop between the 6 and 24 hour values.

I'm working out the elimination rate from the 4-to-12 and 6-to-24 hour drops, which gives a value around 0.1. Next I'm estimating the AUC with trapezoids, which comes to roughly 10.5, and from that I'm getting clearance near 4.8 and volume near 48. Checking the peak time and peak concentration against those numbers fits well, so I'm settling on an absorption rate near 1.1 and noting the 200 dose sits a bit lower per dose, possibly noise, so I'll keep a linear model.
